competing_build_cb1.acceptance: deterministic: all emitted records validate vs EXPERIMENT.schema.json; fork/continuation pairing count exact vs run_history fixture; re-run byte-identical (sha256 equal); run_history hash unchanged
arm_b_shaping_checklist: task rewritten as ONE self-contained issue: full spec, acceptance tests and file scope inside the issue body (Gemini has no workflow_dispatch; nothing may assume on-demand re-dispatch)
no step depends on device routes (deepseek-termux-agent class) or on files outside the repo
steering path named in the issue (issue_comment events only) with a bounded number of steering rounds
shaping verified by doe-expert before either arm is dispatched

arms.route: Gemini, crafted-issue route (event-bound; proven #2732 -> run 41223286134 SUCCESS)

competing_build_cb1.framing_held: framing-a for BOTH arms (arm is the factor here; framing must not confound it)
competing_build_cb1.review_arms: DeepSeek-CI + command-dispatch review both PRs; they are review-arm class, never builders in cb-1
competing_build_cb1.start_gate: arm-B shaping checklist complete AND D2 wave dispatches underway; cb-1 never pre-empts the Nov wave
competing_build_cb1.task: ChronoMancer record emission: an emitter that reads the local run_history SQLite (harmony_hub/workspace/agent/chronomancer.py) and emits fork + continuation as TWO schema-valid EXPERIMENT records, byte-stable on re-run, run_history never mutated
competing_build_cb1.verdict_rule: winner = arm passing acceptance with fewer steering interventions (tie: lower elapsed); loser culled with record retained, winner's approach cherry-picked as the emitter-class template

constraints: zero extra quota: no dispatch, run or session is created for the campaign itself
verdict only vs the pre-registered decision rule
blockers escalate as a specific GitHub comment + report to doe-expert, never as a silent stall

decision_rule.text: Evaluate when >=12 designed dispatches (>=6 per level) across >=2 blocks have records, OR the Nov wave closes 2026-12-04, whichever first. Adopt the winning framing as the default dispatch template iff its primary-rate advantage >= 0.20 AND no contributing block reverses by > 0.20; otherwise no_selection and framing-a (status quo) stays default. Winner propagates by cherry-pick: its template text lands in the dispatch docs via a follow-up PR; the loser level is culled with its records retained (owner definition: rnd + culling + cherry-pick propagation).

assignment.analysis_population: as-assigned (intention-to-treat) primary; as-treated secondary; every deviation recorded in the dispatch record
assignment.binding: slot k of a block takes sequence[k] at issue creation; seats MUST NOT swap, re-draw or cherry-pick; an issue created outside the sequence is OBSERVATIONAL, never re-labelled designed
assignment.rule: pre-registered counterbalanced sequences per block (ABBA form, start level alternates by block so wave-level start is not confounded with project): D2 = [ba,a,a,ba, ba,a,a,ba]; D4 = [a,ba,ba,a, a,ba,ba,a]; M2 = [ba,a,a,ba, ba,a,a,ba]; M3 = [a,ba,ba,a, a,ba,ba,a]; slots beyond 8 repeat the block sequence; a=framing-a, ba=framing-ba

design.blocks: project (D2 | D4 | M2 | M3); within a block, dispatches are paired in dispatch order; the dispatching seat records a pre-assignment size stratum (S|M|L, seat estimate) per task BEFORE seeing its slot assignment
eligibility: genuine build tasks the owning seat would dispatch to Jules anyway (the campaign creates NO dispatch: zero extra quota)
excluded: urgent/incident fixes, security response, tasks whose text cannot carry the template (e.g. one-line config flips) -- exclusions logged with reason, counted, never hidden
a block yielding <2 designed dispatches contributes descriptively only

framing.definition: DO pattern A only (Implement or repair, framework section 4A): issue body = templates/framing-a.md with every canonical field filled; no research phase requested.

DO patterns B>>A (framework sections 4B then 4A): issue body = templates/framing-ba.md; Phase B recon (primary sources, facts/assumptions/gaps separated, gaps ranked) must land as a PR section or issue comment BEFORE implementation evidence; Phase A then implements against the recon.

held_fixed: arm = Jules label route for every designed dispatch (arm is NOT a factor in the main design; arm varies only in competing-build cb-1, framing held there)
identical template skeleton across levels: same field order, same acceptance-evidence demand, same stop/escalation text; levels differ ONLY in the B phase
provider phrases: NOT ESTABLISHED for the Jules route (phrases SSOT = {deepseek} only, recon 2026-10-31); stamped NOT ESTABLISHED, never silently skipped where a set exists and never invented
repo gates, review route and merge oracle unchanged
design.unit_of_observation: one Jules dispatch (one issue -> one session -> one PR) = one EXPERIMENT record

instance_stamps.instance_key_rule: instance_key is computed via scripts/doe/instance_key.py ONLY when provider+model+prompt+tools are all established; while model/tools are NOT ESTABLISHED the record carries treatment.instance = null and the stamp refs in metrics -- a key is never fabricated from partial tuples
instance_stamps.mandatory_per_dispatch: one EXPERIMENT record (docs/ops/corpus/EXPERIMENT.schema.json) in records/, named <block>-<issue_number>.json, with treatment.arm = framing-a|framing-ba and manager_policy_id = doe-mgr-live-builds/live-4/v1
instance_stamps.stamp_fields: system_prompt_ref = prompt:<dispatching-moniker>:<slug>#<sha256[:12] of exact dispatched title+body> (fleet convention, cf. D1 desk-feed rows); tools_ref = NOT ESTABLISHED (Jules API exposes no tool list); model = NOT ESTABLISHED (Jules exposes no model@version); phrases = NOT ESTABLISHED

registration.note: Design + assignment sequences committed BEFORE the first designed dispatch (D2 opens 2026-11-03). No Nov-wave dispatch exists yet under this design; nothing is retro-dressed.

responses.primary: rework-free first-pass merge: PR merged AND repo gate green on the merged head AND 0 corrective follow-up dispatches/reopens AND acceptance evidence present in the PR as the template demands
secondary: sessions_to_merge (Jules sessions + steering messages per issue)
review_rounds (review events per PR, incl. Gemini / DeepSeek-CI / command-dispatch review-arm participation, stamped as review not build)
scope_excursions (changed files outside the issue's stated scope, diff-inspected)
stall_events (action_required / approval-park / failed runs attached to the dispatch)

subject.framing_source: docs/ops/DO-PHRASING-FRAMING-FRAMEWORK.md (canonical structure ACTION+TARGET+OUTCOME+SCOPE+CONSTRAINTS+ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE+STOP/ESCALATION; patterns A-F in section 4)
subject.recon_basis: docs/ops/DOE-RECON-2026-10-31.md conclusions 1-2, as corrected by PR #2787: Jules = only on-demand build arm; Gemini = event-bound, issue-taskable (#2732 proof); DeepSeek-CI = event/review; command-dispatch = review-arm class
subject.system: Nov-wave build dispatches to Jules via agent-jules-on-issues (issue + jules label)
